text: {"lessons":["My early sale of Stock A at a gain felt satisfying, but I should not sell just to lock in a gain; decide based on a consistent plan, not my purchase price.","I held through substantial account declines without trading. Past price moves do not predict future ones, so I should reassess my holdings calmly rather than freeze or react to recent losses.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should set position limits and review my portfolio on a regular schedule, making deliberate decisions instead of avoiding a sale just because it would realize a loss."]}
